Decisions.identity_conflicts: Temporarily hold all graph representations in the existing ten named-sample conflicts
Decisions.upper_bound: Hold log10(cm/s) > -3 using reference-paper upper threshold as a provisional rule
Decisions.lower_bound: Retain original values below -9, flagged; no clipping in this audit
Decisions.disagreement: Hold graph-study-task groups with range >0.5 log units; conservative sensitivity cohort, not mandatory universal cutoff
Decisions.stereo: Retain reported stereochemistry and flag unassigned centers; use connectivity grouping for split sensitivity
Decisions.protocol: Do not require identical protocol; mixing coefficients, pH, inhibitors and ambiguous units requires endpoint-specific resolution
Decisions.deposit_reference: Hold ChEMBL deposited-dataset DOI 10.6019 from the original-study benchmark until its underlying studies are resolved
Decisions.topology: Existing RDKit ring-size >=12 screen retained; chemical classification remains computational
